title: Microsoft FY26 Second Quarter Earnings Conference Call
content:
Now to segment guidance.

In Productivity and Business Processes we expect revenue of $34.25 to $34.55 billion, or growth of 14% to 15%.

In M365 commercial cloud, we expect revenue growth to be between 13% and 14% in constant currency, with continued stability in year-over-year growth rates on a large and expanding base. Accelerating Copilot momentum and ongoing E5 adoption will again drive ARPU growth. [...] Microsoft
